note: How the native port treats every historical unit of config/units.json. Default: a 'game' profile unit is compiled natively UNCHANGED from ../src (with compat/include/port_watcom.h pre-included and, when present, game/protos/<unit>.h). Units with a patch in derive/provenance.json are compiled from their derivative. Checked by tests/test_port_units.py.

replaced_profiles.asm: Hand-written low-level assembly (src/lowlevel_*.asm). Native C implementations of each entry's proven contract (docs/port/ASM_SPEC.md) live in video/ and compat/.
replaced_profiles.hmi: Third-party HMI SOS sound library. Replaced by the port's audio service (platform/), behind the same sos* entry points the game calls.
replaced_profiles.hmi_tasm: Assembly part of the HMI library (timer/DPMI). Replaced together with the library.

replaced_units.src/dosmem.c: DPMI wrappers (allocate/free conventional memory, real-mode interrupt) that pass 32-bit linear addresses to INT 31h; implemented by compat/src/dos_services.c with the same contracts.

unit_defines_reason.src/pcmain.c: The DOS program's `void main(int, char**)` becomes the ordinary function rayman_dos_main; the SDL3 host owns the process entry point and calls it.
